coordination.nonduplicate_scope: PR1231 carries internal HCU candidate/simulation packets; PR1263 carries a reactive HCU router. Neither supplies the current-facing typed Xeno ingress/admission/dispatch-generation primitive on main.

grf.observed: Current owner frontier explicitly requires typed Xeno Entry Fabric; current-facing Xeno source had architecture contract but no executable XenoIngressPacket implementation found on main.
grf.hypothesis: A strict deterministic ingress binding with one generation check at admission is sufficient for safe dispatch.
grf.counterhypothesis: An admitted packet can remain queued across an entity-generation rollover and become stale before cognition; admission-only self-consistency does not close this TOCTOU/replay gap.
grf.cheapest_discriminator: Admit generation-7 packet and receipt, change only live current generation to 8, compare naive admission-only self-consistency against a live dispatch fence.
grf.fusion: Bind producer event identity plus packet/receipt digests at admission and require a second live-generation + canonical-receipt check immediately before cognition dispatch. Durable replay state remains external in canonical state authority.

unusual_experiment.name: ENTRY_ADMISSION_TO_DISPATCH_GENERATION_TOCTOU
unusual_experiment.intervention: Packet and receipt remain unchanged after live generation rolls from 7 to 8.
unusual_experiment.observed_mechanism: validate_for_dispatch rejects the unchanged packet with StaleGenerationError against live generation 8
unusual_experiment.note: Other focused cases are deterministic regressions, not additional unusual experiments.
